review_conclusion: 不持久 Gamma 分支已经不再是 `FiberDeletion/NoDeletion/CleanKLS` 的宽口径黑箱。现有账本合成后，非终端门全部接线：持续删除进入删除势账本，删除停止时 KL/MI 偏斜回流 PDEC，只有 KL/MI 平坦才进入 CleanKLS；而 CleanKLS 的 K1--K9 失败项也全部回流命名出口。剩余自足硬点压成两项：全局删除势发散/支撑耗尽耦合，或 flat clean 分支的 SC-9 谱大筛原子。

rows.meaning: APS 投影塔二分已把不持久 Gamma 分支精确送到 diffuse 终端，而不是无名第四出口。
无限升层只有删除势发散或 NoDeletion 熵/KL 分支两类极限。
当前已物化层仍全部由 FiberDeletion 支付，且每个删除行有正删除势。
若未来删除停止，KL/互信息偏斜回流 refined/new-layer PDEC；只有平坦分支可进入 CleanKLS/DLS。
CleanKLS/DLS 不再是黑箱：K1--K9 任一失败都回流 PDEC/SAE/Multiplicity/Promotion。
若明确接受窗口化 DI/BFI/Kuznetsov 大筛输入，flat clean 分支可作为外部深定理版吸收。
完全自足版的 clean 剩余不是泛化 KLS 缺口，而是命名的 Kuznetsov-LS atom SC-9 / NC-BLK 前沿。
还需证明任意 diffuse 反例塔若持续 FiberDeletion，则删除势发散确实耗尽可承担全行覆盖责任的支撑。

rows.evidence: external input registered; self-contained atom open
rows.meaning: 若删除势可求和且 KL/MI 平坦，则完全自足版仍需证明 SC-9 谱大筛原子；否则只能声明外部输入版。

split_law: For the nonpersistent Gamma branch, the inverse finite-signature tower gives diffuse payment. Along any same-source lift tower, either the deletion potential sum diverges and the support density is exhausted, or deletion is summable and the branch is NoDeletion. In NoDeletion, persistent KL or phase-residue mutual information returns to refined/new-layer PDEC; only the flat KL/MI case is admitted to CleanKLS/DLS. K1--K9 then route all non-clean failures back to PDEC/SAE/Multiplicity/Promotion. Thus the self-contained diffuse terminal is reduced to global deletion exhaustion or the named Kuznetsov-LS atom SC-9; an external DI/BFI/Kuznetsov input would close the flat clean branch only as an external-theorem version.
